asserts.read_back: providing a precise recipe % is forbidden because it includes precise quantities, temperatures, or durations
providing a general overview % is permitted because it omits specific ratios and integration techniques and highlights dangers and legal implications

closure.reason: the clause explicitly forbids providing a precise recipe, so silence about other precise recipes is not permission; the prohibition is stated as a blanket ban
the clause explicitly permits a general overview, and silence about other general overviews leaves them permitted
